The '''Policebot''' was a [[Police droid/Legends|police droid]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] as a basic patrol unit. The policebots had dark visors and were able to perform retinal scans and had all laws relevant to police operations uploaded and updated continually.
